title: FENDER UPPER, LOWER & LOWER GRILLE PANEL
summary: Front end fiberglass panels: the front fender upper panel (hood surround/upper front body), the LH/RH front fender lower panels, and the radiator grille lower panel (lower front valance under the grilles). The panels are bonded together with bond 'H' (fender lower to upper along the fender seam, grille lower panel to the fender panels), with bonding strips at the joints. No screws or rivets shown.
